title: Warmly Spiced Turkish Lamb Kofte
description: A tangy and crumbly solo dinner Turkish dish featuring chilled butter and pickle, made with whole30 friendly ingredients, formed into kofte.
instructions: Preheat the oven to 400 degrees Fahrenheit.
In a large bowl, combine the ground lamb, chilled butter, pickle, onion, garlic, paprika, cumin, salt, and black pepper.
Mix the ingredients together with your hands until just combined, being careful not to overmix.
Use your hands to shape the mixture into 8 kofte, each about 1 1/2 inches long and 1 inch in diameter.
Place the kofte on a baking sheet lined with parchment paper, leaving about 1 inch of space between each kofte.
Bake the kofte in the preheated oven for 18 minutes, or until cooked through to an internal temperature of 145 degrees Fahrenheit.
Remove the kofte from the oven and let them rest for 5 minutes before serving.
Serve the kofte hot, garnished with chopped fresh parsley or cilantro if desired.
